Vibrant and contemporary, CAKE create stunning original prints for the womenswear and lifestyle markets. Our talented team of artists take inspiration from the latest trends, catwalks and the colourful world around us. Always driven by a passion to deliver dazzling designs with a feminine and commercial eye. We work with fashion houses, retailers and manufacturers around the world. Our prints can be seen in-store and on runways in the UK and Europe, USA, South America, Australia and the Far East. To see our latest collection or for job opportunities, please contact us here For all the latest CAKE news follow us on Instagram, Facebook or Twitter. PROCESS Whether the creative process begins with paint, pencil or pixel the same care and attention goes into creating our unique artworks. The designs are supplied digitally as a layered Photoshop PSD file ready for commercial use and often with repeat elements included. OUR CLIENTS CAKE are proud to work with some of the leading fashion brands in the UK and around the world. Our designs can be seen in: VINTAGE In addition to our original prints CAKE also has a curated archive of beautiful vintage garments and fabric samples that are also for sale. These can be viewed by appointment. To see the collection please contact the studio. Your Name (required) Your Email (required) Subject Your Message (C) Cake Studios Ltd.
